# Mini Game Arcade

> Mini Game Arcade is a fast, responsive, curated collection of 16 original browser-based mini-games built with vanilla HTML5, Canvas 2D, and Web Audio API. Zero external runtime dependencies, no account or installation required, instant play on mobile and desktop.

Mini Game Arcade provides instant-play casual, arcade, action, and puzzle games engineered for speed, accessibility, and high performance. All visual effects, physics, and game audio are generated procedurally in the browser, featuring local high-score tracking, accessible touch and keyboard controls, and full offline PWA support.

Website: https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/

## Featured Games

- [Citrus Blitz](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/citrus-blitz): Fast-paced fruit-slicing arcade action with procedural Canvas 2D physics, dynamic blade swipe trails, bomb hazards, combo multipliers, and Blitz and Survival modes.
- [Hidden Hunt](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/hidden-hunt): Premium hidden-object adventure puzzle game featuring 15 hand-illustrated scenes across The Old Library, Mystery Forest, and Pirate's Treasure with zoom and pan controls, smart hints, and daily observation challenges.

## Playable Arcade & Action Games

- [Dashverse](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/dashverse): High-octane cyberpunk rooftop parkour runner. Vault chasms, double jump over rooftop vents, slide under laser barriers, collect data shards, and complete courier missions.
- [Stack Rush](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/stack-rush): One-button 3D tower stacking game. Time horizontal block drops across alternating axes, trim overlapping edges with realistic debris physics, and build ascending chime combos.
- [Brick Breaker](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/brick-breaker): Retro-arcade neon breakout with 100% Canvas 2D physics, angle-deflecting paddle rebounds, multi-ball power-ups, particle shatter bursts, and 3 progressive waves.
- [Space Dodge](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/space-dodge): Pilot an agile cyber starship through asteroid belts, dodge plasma comets, collect energy crystals, execute near-miss dodges, and trigger EMP shockwaves across 3 sectors or Endless Hyperspace.
- [Tap Challenge](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/tap-challenge): High-speed reaction and agility arena featuring Reflex Rush, Number Sprint sequence tests, and a 10-second CPS click speed frenzy with combo multipliers.

## Playable Puzzle & Strategy Games

- [Circuit Connect](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/circuit-connect): Logic puzzle connecting matching neon color terminals across 30 handcrafted levels with a 100% board fill constraint and built-in smart hint solver.
- [Merge Grid](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/merge-grid): Strategic 4x4 sliding number tile puzzle. Slide and merge matching values toward 2048 with full undo history, best-score tracking, and swipe controls.
- [Jigpic Solitaire](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/jigpic-solitaire): Relaxing jigsaw and solitaire hybrid. Assemble picturesque picture blocks step by step across warm landscapes, blooming gardens, and coastal scenes.
- [Water Sort](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/water-sort): Color-sorting liquid logic puzzle. Sort vibrant liquids into clear glass test tubes with fluid stream animations, multi-step undo, hints, extra tube assists, and 150+ solvable stages.
- [Block Puzzle](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/block-puzzle): 8x8 polyomino block-fitting game. Place pieces to clear horizontal rows and vertical columns across Classic Endless, 10-Line Challenge, and 90-Second Timed Blitz.
- [Number Puzzle](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/number-puzzle): Definitive classic 15-puzzle sliding challenge with 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 grid modes, move counters, stopwatch tracking, and 100% solvability guarantee.
- [Tic Tac Toe](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/tic-tac-toe): Classic 3x3 strategy game featuring an unbeatable Minimax AI bot and two-player pass-and-play on the same device with match timers and scoreboard tracking.

## Playable Casual Games

- [Memory Match](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/memory-match): Visual recall card-matching challenge across Easy (8 cards), Medium (16 cards), and Hard (24 cards) modes with 3D card flips, move counters, and star ratings.
- [Bubble Pop](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/games/bubble-pop): Classic arcade bubble shooter with reflective laser aiming, hexagonal grid snapping, Match-3 bursting, color swaps, and falling island avalanches.

## Category Hubs

- [Arcade Games Hub](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/category/arcade): Fast-paced reflex, stacking, and slicing browser games.
- [Action Games Hub](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/category/action): High-energy parkour running, space dodging, and brick-breaking games.
- [Puzzle Games Hub](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/category/puzzle): Logic, flow, tile-sliding, hidden-object, and polyomino puzzle challenges.
- [Casual Games Hub](https://mini-game-arcade-coral.vercel.app/category/casual): Relaxing card-matching, bubble shooting, and picture jigsaw games.
